announcements.headline: Update on Subsidiary Licence in Kazakhstan
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited provides an update on a subsidiary licence in Kazakhstan. This follows earlier announcements regarding covenant compliance, dividend distribution, and interim results.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow the July covenant compliance update and September interim results. This confirms governance actions taken after the restoration of listing.

announcements.headline: Principal Subsidiary Share Split
announcements.insight: Following the July restoration of listing, this subsidiary share split is a minor capital action. Shareholders should monitor subsequent covenant compliance updates.

announcements.headline: Notification Interim Results, period to June 2026
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited reports interim results for June 2026. This follows FY25 results and covenant updates in June and July.

announcements.headline: Update on Subsidiary Dividend Distribution
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited updates shareholders on subsidiary dividend distribution. This follows earlier FY25 results and covenant compliance announcements.

announcements.headline: Covenant Compliance and Lender Waiver Update
announcements.insight: Following FY25 results and suspension in May-June, this update addresses covenant compliance and lender waivers. It signals continued financial distress and potential further restructuring risks for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Further re Restoration of Listing and Trading
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited lifts its share suspension following FY25 results. This restores trading after the May and June filings.

announcements.headline: Results for Y/E 31 Dec 2025 and Suspension Lift
announcements.insight: Suspension was lifted following FY25 results. SIBJ Capital LLC is now involved in the audited consolidation process.

announcements.headline: Statement re Notification of FY25 Results
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited has published its FY25 audited consolidated results. This follows an earlier notification regarding SIBJ Capital LLC in May 2026.

announcements.headline: FY25 Audited Consolidated Results SIBJ Capital LLC
announcements.insight: ICFG Limited has released its FY25 audited consolidated results alongside SIBJ Capital LLC. Shareholders should review the financial performance and any strategic implications for the business.
